description: This Java class 'BankingServiceHelper' provides methods to convert between domain objects and entity/model objects related to banking, such as Customer, Account, Address, Contact, BankInfo, Transaction, and TransferDetails.

classes.name: BankingServiceHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing conversion methods between domain and entity models for banking-related data.

methods.name: convertToCustomerDomain
methods.description: Converts a Customer entity object to a CustomerDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToCustomerEntity
methods.description: Converts a CustomerDetails domain object to a Customer entity object.

methods.name: convertToAccountDomain
methods.description: Converts an Account entity object to an AccountInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToAccountEntity
methods.description: Converts an AccountInformation domain object to an Account entity object.

methods.name: convertToAddressDomain
methods.description: Converts an Address entity object to an AddressDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToAddressEntity
methods.description: Converts an AddressDetails domain object to an Address entity object.

methods.name: convertToContactDomain
methods.description: Converts a Contact entity object to a ContactDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToContactEntity
methods.description: Converts a ContactDetails domain object to a Contact entity object.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoDomain
methods.description: Converts a BankInfo entity object to a BankInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoEntity
methods.description: Converts a BankInformation domain object to a BankInfo entity object.

methods.name: convertToTransactionDomain
methods.description: Converts a Transaction entity object to a TransactionDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToTransactionEntity
methods.description: Converts a TransactionDetails domain object to a Transaction entity object.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Creates a Transaction object based on TransferDetails, account number, and transaction type.
